title: Measurement of octanol–air and air–water partition coefficients of isopropyl and isobutyl nitrate
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1843-1853
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00940E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ariana J. Buss, Kevin D. Easterbrook, Van Khanh Le, Dmitry N. Ivanov, Nicole Sandblom, Hans D. Osthoff
This work provides the first experimental determination of Henry's law solubility constants (HcpS ≡ H) in n-octanol (Hoct) for isopropyl and isobutyl nitrate (IPN and IBN) over the 284.65 K to 309.65 K temperature (T) range.
